mentions.name: Minecraft MCP project
mentions.description: An MCP integration for Minecraft where AI models analyze topographic maps of the terrain and build in the game using Starlark scripts. The map-based approach keeps tool calls low, making it fast enough to run in voice mode.
mentions.source_excerpt: Still working on my Minecraft MCP project. The models have good image analysis now so I'm feeding them topographic maps of the terrain and they build using Starlark scripts.
mentions.author: wmil
